decisions.reason: Its continued own-page presence and fit with the established offer suggest results meet or exceed aspirations, so no problemistic search is triggered.
Its demotion to a mere website mention signals performance below aspiration, triggering problemistic search and making a drop likely as resources are reallocated.
Although its reduced visibility suggests possible underperformance, it is a building-block tool for the platform and organisational slack allows keeping it while its contribution is evaluated.
